transkript.t: If you go to this repo, you can actually build a one-person agency company with 200 agents.
It's called Agency Agents, and it has already crossed 155,000 stars and 25,000 forks on GitHub,
which tells you how many builders are quietly using it. So what is it? It's an open-source
library of more than 200 AI agents, and everyone is a specialist with its own personality,
workflow, deliverables, and way of measuring success. These aren't generic prompts. Each
agent is a carefully written role, so when you activate one, your AI stops behaving like a chatbot
and starts behaving like a hired expert. And the roster is organized exactly like a real agency.
You get an engineering division with front-end developers, back-end architects, AI engineers,
and code reviewers. You get a design division, a marketing team, a sales team, finance team,
and sitting on top of all of them is an agents orchestrator, which acts like your
operations head and coordinates multiple agents on one big project. Follow for useful AI ideas
